resources.string: Hapana zviziviso pakuvhura kana mabhena. Shandisa widget pasina muganhu uchinyoresa.
Kunyoresa kunovandudzwa otomatiki pamwedzi. Kanzura chero nguva paGoogle Play; kushandisa kunoenderera kusvika nguva yakabhadharwa yapera.
Kunyoresa hakuwanikwi. Tarisa akaundi yako yeGoogle Play woedza kudzorera zvakatengwa.
Mubhadharo wakamirira. Kushandisa kunotanga kana wasimbiswa.
Hapana kunyoresa kuri kushanda kwakawanikwa paakaundi iyi yeGoogle Play.
Kutenga hakuna kusimbiswa. Edza kudzorera zvakatengwa zvakare.
Haufaniri kuona zviziviso kana kuwedzera nguva kunyoresa kuchiri kushanda.
Usati wabvuma, simbisa kuti Google Play iri kuratidza nzira yekubhadhara yekuedza. Nzira chaiyo inogona kubvisirwa mari.
